# git API reference

Distributed version control system.

## Command tree

```text
git
├── version
├── init
├── status
├── add
├── commit
├── log
├── revParse
├── remote
│   ├── add
│   ├── remove
│   └── getUrl
└── config
    ├── get
    ├── set
    └── list
```

## Commands

| Group | Description |
|---|---|
| [`version`](./commands/version.md) | Print the git version. |
| [`init`](./commands/init.md) | Create an empty git repository. |
| [`status`](./commands/status.md) | Show the working tree status. |
| [`add`](./commands/add.md) | Add file contents to the index. |
| [`commit`](./commands/commit.md) | Record staged changes to the repository. |
| [`log`](./commands/log.md) | Show commit history. |
| [`revParse`](./commands/revParse.md) | Resolve revisions and repository metadata. |
| [`remote`](./commands/remote.md) | Manage the set of tracked repositories. |
| [`config`](./commands/config.md) | Read and write repository configuration. |
